blocks.text: Attacker activities are recorded as events and displayed as a graph on the Investigate page. You can evaluate the attacker's actions and how they interact with Zscaler Deception elements (decoys, decoy connectors, etc.). You can also see additional details of these activities from ThreatParse along with timelines and network maps to know when and how the attack happened, view the event logs, and download evidence like PCAP files, RDP session recordings, and IoCs for a detailed investigation.

blocks.item: In the left-side navigation, click Investigate.
On the Investigate page, click an element on the graph. For example, click an attacker icon.
In the details pane, click View Extended Details.
ThreatParse: Attack details based on the MITRE ATT&CK framework along with a risk score in plain English. To learn more, see Viewing ThreatParse Details.
Chronology: A temporal overview and heatmap of the attacker's activities. To learn more, see Viewing Attack Chronology Details.
Network: Details of the attacker's activity in your network based on the telemetry generated by network decoys. To learn more, see Viewing Network Details.
Event Logs: Event logs associated with an attacker activity. To learn more, see Viewing and Managing Event Logs.
Evidence: Evidence of an attack on the PCAP, RDP, or IoC files. To learn more, see Viewing and Managing Evidence.
